en: A vintage monochrome (blue‑tinted) postcard view of a river harbor with several sailing ships and small rowing boats anchored along the waterfront. In the foreground is a rocky shoreline with a simple wooden railing and two seated figures looking toward the water. Low buildings and masts line the opposite bank. Printed text at the top left reads "PERNAU Der Fluss," and there is a small handwritten note in blue ink on the right side of the water.
